pilots.name: Wren Halloway
pilots.bio: A Concord flight-school washout who turned out to fly better than her instructors. She wants a captain who goes places, and she will tell you so.

lines.join: Wren Halloway straps in. "Try to keep up, captain."
lines.eject: I'm out! I'm out! Pick me up at a port!
lines.back: Wren Halloway is back in a fresh Kestrel, and annoyed about the last one.

pilots.name: Juno Marsh
pilots.bio: Ex-Reach militia, retired twice and bored both times. She flies a patched-up Warden and talks to it more than to people.

lines.join: Juno Marsh pats her console. "Right then, old girl. Work."
lines.back: Juno Marsh is back, in a Warden she swears is the same one.

pilots.name: Tamsin Reyes
pilots.bio: A rim courier who has outrun every raider in the dark lanes, and remembers each by name. Cheap, quick, and very hard to hit.

lines.join: Tamsin Reyes grins over the comm. "Fast is a kind of armour, you know."
lines.back: Tamsin Reyes is back with a new Courier and a story about the old one.

pilots.name: Silas Crowe
pilots.bio: Nobody in the Unlit asks where Silas Crowe learned to fight. He doesn't drink, doesn't smile, and doesn't miss.

lines.join: Silas Crowe nods once. That is all you get.
lines.back: Silas Crowe returns without a word, in a new Warden.

arrive: So you're the one they talk about in the bars. Let's see.
Back again? Good. I hate an easy week.
I've been waiting for you, captain.
Nice ship. It'll look better in pieces.
escape: Enjoy it. I'll be back with something bigger.
lines.gloat: Kade Varro laughs over the comm as you limp away. "Same time next week?"
lines.final: Kade Varro's pod tumbles away, and his voice is quiet for once. "All right, captain. You win. Find someone else to haunt you."
